index 4cf9025..4f83765 100644
--- a/lsize.py
+++ b/lsize.py
@@ -2,9 +2,24 @@
 import os
 import sys
 
+_UNITS = ("KB", "MB", "GB")
+
 
 def format_size(n):
-    return f"{n} B"
+    """Human-readable size using powers of 1000 (matches Finder).
+
+    Under 1000 bytes stays as bytes (e.g. '512 B'); otherwise KB/MB/GB with
+    one decimal place (e.g. '1.5 KB'). Sizes of a TB or more stay in GB.
+    """
+    if n < 1000:
+        return f"{n} B"
+    value = n / 1000
+    i = 0
+    # Roll over when rounding to one decimal would show 1000.0 of a unit.
+    while i < len(_UNITS) - 1 and value >= 999.95:
+        value /= 1000
+        i += 1
+    return f"{value:.1f} {_UNITS[i]}"
